steps.text: Penguin Logistics Lungmen Crib

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Eh? Ehhh? Now this isn't right!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You lost.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm done. This is no fun. You win every time.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why don't we watch a movie instead.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Want any snacks?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The usual.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You got it.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Here, your favorite biscuits.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmm... The explosion in this scene isn't quite up to snuff. It's nowhere as good as what I put together back in school.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The Ursus actress playing the lead looks kinda familiar though...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmm? You blew stuff up before too?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You could say that.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh, how come you never told me about it. What's the story?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's not worth talking about.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Come on, tell me. I promise I won't tell anyone.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Did you blow up a school? An assembly hall? Something else, hm?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I think it was a tower...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You blew up a tower?!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah, a tower. A leaning tower, to be precise.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It was kinda... a landmark there.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Whoa, I bet you didn't get out of that one easy.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I did it for the Family.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Not like you, still blowing things up left and right even after you were reprimanded.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, about that.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: School's meant to be fun. Of course I had to do the most fun thing I could possibly do.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Besides, I don't actually want to get anything blown up. It's just...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Just what?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I have these little accidents whenever I'm pulling my pranks...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Let's take that one time with Mostima for example.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I was just going to give her a little scare.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Scare who? Mostima?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah, we went to the same school, and she was a real model student. She would give these speeches...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And so this one time, I installed a little spring platform on the way up to the podium, and, uh...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: She got sprung right up?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course not. She leaped over it and got through without a scratch.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The other girl who was right behind her wasn't so lucky, though.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What does that have to do with blowing stuff up?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm getting to that.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I guess you wouldn't know, but, in Laterano, we carry guns and live rounds to these events as a show of respect.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And, well, it just so happens that girl was carrying a heavy weapon.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm not sure if she did that out of instinct or experience, but she fired her weapon to propel herself and land safely.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The thing is, there was a load-bearing column where she shot her grenade, so that blew open a corner of the assembly hall.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Were you really just playing a prank?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I was! I didn't mean to at all!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hah... If you dared pull something like that in Siracusa, you would've been killed the very next day.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Getting your head chopped off is the best deal. You hardly feel any pain that way.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If you embarrass somebody in public, things won't be as easy.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You might get your hands and legs chopped off, gagged, and tossed in the river—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: —They might even fish you out just to hang your corpse up on the streetcorner to warn anyone who might come up with a funny idea like you.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hahaha...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You're kidding, right...?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm not.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Stop scaring me... I didn't know better when I was still in school. I wouldn't dare do anything like that these days!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm a hardworking girl nowadays. You won't find me giving anyone any trouble.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's just... sometimes... Uh...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I kinda wanna do something just to pull a prank on the boss. What do you think?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Considering how destructive your pranks get, I suggest you—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Oh... Bo—

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Who just slapped—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, hey, Boss. You're early today. Ahaha...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: What? I got nothin' else to do, might as well check on my girls.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Turns out we don't have any work now either. Haha.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: No work? Here's something for you, then.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aha, here we go.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Get your ass movin' and deliver this for me.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Here's the address.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Alright, I got it. I'm leaving now.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, you go too. It's from the stinkin' old rat. You know what a pain that crusty-ass mouse is.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Got it...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Come back quick. The vinyls those bitches owe me are gonna be here soon. You two are haulin' that shit for me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You can count on us!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ugh, why is there a traffic jam at this time of the day?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It doesn't make sense.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Did the guys from that other company crash their street racers again?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Eh, Texas, you've been spacing out the whole time. Something on your mind?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Texas?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (Going by the address, this package is for the Siracusan mafia we ran into last time.)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (But they don't work for the Rat King anymore. Why does he want us to deliver their packages?)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: T—e—x—a—s—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Huh?! What's wrong? An ambush?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Nothing but cars here. No room for an ambush.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Texas, is this package for those guys in black we beat up a few months ago?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: How'd you figure?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I mean, we're in logistics. We catch wind of lots of things on the job.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Whenever I deliver to that area, it's usually Lupos signing for the goods.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Besides, a lot of the people there hang up black hats and black jackets at home. It's not hard to tell.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Pretty sure they're the only ones in Lungmen who dress like that.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Eh, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Speaking of the mafia, I'm curious.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Did you used to dress like that in Siracusa?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Black suit and white shirt?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No, I wore a white tux and red shirt.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hm... That sounds like it could look pretty good.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So you didn't dress up like everyone else?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No, I didn't.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What a maverick.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's something the Family's key members have to do to make our power and authority known. We dressed differently from your normal Lupo lackeys.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Doesn't that make you really stand out, though? Especially when everyone's wearing all black.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You sure no one's going to just—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Bang!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Off you from a distance like that?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Most mafia bosses are concerned about safety. They'll always have someone from the Family watching potential sniper nests.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But if something like that does actually happen...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'll slice the bolts in half myself.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Then I'll go full damnatio memoriae on their Family. Wipe the name from Siracusa.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Or should I say that's what I would've done?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: These days... I guess it doesn't really matter anymore.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's the boss's problem to figure out how to take care of our rivals.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: All we have to do is deliver things where we're told, and maybe fight a few fights on the way. That's it.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You have a point. Yeah, you're right.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Say, how long has this traffic jam been going?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Half an hour?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: This isn't going to work out if we don't get moving soon.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Look, the driver next to us is yelling at someone already.

steps.name: Irritated Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: (Slams the horn repeatedly)

steps.name: Irritated Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: (Lowers the car's window)

steps.name: Irritated Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Hey, frickin' puk gaai, get a move on already!

steps.name: Carefree Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: What's the rush, buddy? I'm stuck here myself.

steps.name: Carefree Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Look around you. We're all in this together.

steps.name: Irritated Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Yiu ah nei! If my deal gets called off, I'm gonna sau nei pei!

steps.name: Carefree Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Dai lo, I'm trying to get home to the wife too, but this is a traffic jam. Ain't no one to blame for that.

steps.name: Carefree Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: If waiting for the cars to move ain't up to your taste, why don't we play some cards?

steps.name: Carefree Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Maybe listen to the radio. News has been interesting lately.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (Tunes radio to the traffic channel)

steps.name: Traffic Broadcast
steps.text: According to reports, two vehicles were involved in a crash on the city beltway. By the time the L.G.D. has arrived on scene, the drivers had already left the scene of the accident.

steps.name: Traffic Broadcast
steps.text: The police are currently interviewing witnesses for descriptions of the drivers and moving the vehicles off the road. All lanes of the beltway should be open again very soon.

steps.name: Traffic Broadcast
steps.text: Next up, we have another traffic report—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That sounds kinda familiar, doesn't it, Texas?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Maybe we should check up on our buddies?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (Tunes radio channel)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hello, do you copy?
Howdy doo, Texas?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Croissant, what's going on?
(Sounds of bolts flying around)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We're gettin' robbed!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Did your car break down?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Purdy sure, but I reckon we'n fix 'er up.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Now don't you go snitchin' on me to the baws. Wanna keep my bonus fer the month, thank'yee.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Well, I won't keep you. See you tonight.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I thought I was the only one who'd do that.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You seem to do pretty well too.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's cause—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ow!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If this traffic jam doesn't let up soon, Boss isn't going to be happy.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai, I'll take the package and go on ahead. Come as soon as the highway opens up.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Maybe I should handle the delivery.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Do you know what to say when you greet the mafia men?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Something like, 'Penguin Logistics, delivery—'

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If you try to do that, it'll end up just as bad as that one night.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's a fight. I'm not scared of them.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are you sure about that? They're our customers this time.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If you are planning on beating them up and then having them sign for the package, I will say nothing more.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh... right...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And that's why it's better that I go.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: At the very least, they are terrified of the name 'Texas,' and that will smooth most things over.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Here's the key.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The key? What key?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You want me to drive?!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Just for the time being.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'll drive on the way back.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Don't crash the car. Got it?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You can trust me to handle anything!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And I just don't...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Never mind.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'll see you later.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hm? How come Texas left her sword in the car?
Lungmen Markets

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (Taking this alley should save me some time.)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (I'm almost to Kang Chai Street.)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (No. 8. Looks like a big warehouse. This is the place.)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (I hope I'll get to leave as soon as I have this delivered...)
No. 8, Kang Chai Street, Lungmen Markets

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Texas?!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: S-Stop! Not a step further!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (They switched to rubber arrowheads. Looks like they're starting to follow the rules.)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm only here for a delivery.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Leave it there. We'll have someone come take it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I need to deliver it to the addressee and have it signed for. Only then can I leave.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: (Whispers) Hey, what should we do?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: (Whispers) Let's ask her who it's for first.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: We'll call the addressee and have them come out. Gimme the name.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Enrico.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Boss?!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: (Whispers) Hey!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Uhh—*Cough*!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Wait here. I'll bring Mr. Enrico out right away.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: (Whispers) Hang in there. I'll be back soon.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: T-Texas... ma'am...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: You don't have any weapons on you, right?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: None at all.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: You won't pull out an Originium sword and kill us all, will you?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Just like when you offed the whole Conte Family?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You know the rules here. Lungmen's rules.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Right. Yes, you're right.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: (Phew, thank goodness...)

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Mr. Enrico, this way.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: I'm Enrico, Signora Texas.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: I heard you have something for me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's right. A delivery.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's from the Rat King. Please sign for it.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Rat King?

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Alright. Let me see it.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: (Opens the package)

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: My...

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Yes, this is from the Rat King.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Where do I sign?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Right here. On the bottom right.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Very well—Here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Now then—

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Please spare me a moment, Signora Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's a title for the Family leadership back in Siracusa, not me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Call me Texas.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Right, sure, Texas.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: As you can see, it has been years since my brothers and I came here to Lungmen.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: A while ago, Capone and Gambino got themselves pushed out of the city... they challenged the authority here, and got what came to them. That got me pushed up to lead the Family.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: I want to ask your advice. If you would, please come inside for a chat.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't have much advice for you.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: I'm all ears.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Will you and your brothers ever go back to Siracusa?

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Hoh, we'll most likely stay here in Lungmen.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: There is nothing waiting for us in Siracusa. Just the Sicilian bosslady's henchmen waiting to kill us.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: In that case, you might want to give up on living like a Siracusan.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Try to live like a Lungmenite.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm sure you know much better than anyone else whether fights between families work here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Whether you are from Higashi, Ursus, or Siracusa, if you want to settle down here, there is only one way.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Be a Lungmenite.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You aren't the first ones to come here, and you won't be the last.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Gang members come and go. In the end, the only ones that will remain are Lungmenite.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's all I'm going to tell you.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Farewell.

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Are you a Lungmenite?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But I will go back one day.
*Rattle*
*Beep*—*beep*—!

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: What's that sound...?

steps.name: Mafia Boss
steps.text: Is it coming from the box?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, done already?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I thought you'd be back by the time the road opened.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We had a little chat.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I didn't know you knew how to make conversation.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I was just trying to keep them from giving the boss any more trouble. That's all.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Really? Sounds like they're pretty amenable.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But, eh, look behind you. What's with these guys running outside?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Like, they're coming after you, aren't they? They don't seem very friendly to me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There's a small problem...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I heard a noise when I was leaving. Looks like the boss made... a few modifications before handing the package over to us.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What do we do now? Fight them?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Fight them? Just go!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This entire neighborhood is full of mafiosos. Do you want the boss to dock your pay for another car?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, right.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Give me the keys. Let's go!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Haah—

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Eurill's a bigass cow, but he knows his wine, I'll give him that.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Once we're done with the vinyls, Imma get a few more crates from him.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Took your sweet time, didn't you? The vinyl damn near grew legs and walked up here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Wasn't the package for the mafia from the Rat King?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yeah, it's the crusty rat's goods. I made a few tweaks to it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Those bitches in black think they can get away with blowing up my vinyl collection?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: They gonna think again.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: So, Texas, did the punks freak when they heard me rappin' after that countdown?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: None at all.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: They didn't? No way!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I wrote this one special for those clowns. Even grabbed me a random Lupo off the street and tried it out on him before hittin' the booth. He didn't last five seconds.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Your rap didn't knock them out. Actually, they started chasing us after a few verses.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We drove all across Lungmen for the better part of the day just to get away from them.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Gotta be your problem.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I figured your average delivery time and worked it into the plan.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I had a few extra minutes of nothin' in there when I was recording and then gave that delay button a few taps just to give you two time to get away.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Oh, I got it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Did that Lupo ask you something 'cause of your name again?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: See, I thought of that. You see how my mind works?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: They got no idea. I prepped that warm-up just for them.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: After a wild, intense chase, they go home and listen to this badass tape.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: A l'il angry, and a l'il pissed.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: This is gonna keep them out of breath and snuff 'em out.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Wei said no bullets, but he didn't say nothing about no rapping.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ahahahahaha.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Now back to work. Carry those vinyls for me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes, Boss...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Where's Exusiai?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: She's reloading her rubber bullets.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Tell her to get a move on. The vinyls ain't waiting.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Right...
